description: Says whether the signed-in member holds the Desk Pass, when it renews or ends, how many forecasts they have left this week and when more come. Call it when someone asks about their Desk Pass or their forecasts. It takes no arguments. Needs a signed-in member, because it answers about them. A key with no member gets the error member_required.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

name: get_desk_pass
title: Your Desk Pass and forecasts
